source.repro: npx esbuild plugins/maf/benches/mafOnMarks.bench.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/mafOnMarks.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=14000 /tmp/mafOnMarks.mjs --rounds=9 --identity --json
source.notes: On ada (24 cores, load 13-16), a collection before each arm. One fetched region of the synthetic MAF-tabix fixture per shape, identity per species over 64 bp bins. MAF display is the worker's pack, placeMafRegionData and buildIdentityRuns; control is the same declared again. Cells then bin is the declared identity with `cells` writing its runs and ADR-197's bin-and-aggregate kernel binning them (the bench's bin-fused-typed-identity arm); walk is the same declaration as the display runs it, `cells`, bin and aggregate as binnedCellMatches (typed-identity). Both include mafFeatureTableOf, the species split and the encode as a bar's y. Interleaved round-robin with the order rotated, MIN across rounds. Error is the distance from bases matched over bases compared per species and bin, counted off the text; the walk's rows are checked equal to the three steps' before timing. A second run the same hour put walk vs cells then bin at 0.56-0.73x and walk vs MAF display at 0.92-1.58x.
